observations.behavior: Adds a new configuration option FEATURE_FLAG_LAST_CALLED_AT_SYNC_SOURCE with default value "events" and a fallback to "events" for unknown values.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows switching the source table used by the feature flag last-called-at sync task between "events" and "flag_evaluations".

observations.behavior: Adds a new configuration option FEATURE_FLAG_LAST_CALLED_AT_SYNC_FLAG_EVALUATIONS_BUFFER_SECONDS with a default value of 900 seconds, used when the source is "flag_evaluations".
observations.posthog_connection: Provides a configurable buffer for the flag_evaluations source, accounting for ClickHouse consumer lag, while retaining the replication buffer for the events source.

observations.behavior: Adds documentation for the new configuration option FEATURE_FLAG_LAST_CALLED_AT_SYNC_SOURCE in the task's docstring.
